verdict.rationale: Connection pooling is a fair question for a distributed SQL database, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions a built-in pooler or handling thousands of concurrent connections. PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility only means standard clients and drivers can connect, which is adjacent and does not show built-in pooling, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, a built-in connection pooler handles thousands of concurrent connections without me operating my own pgbouncer or proxy
